title: malus communis subsp. sylvestris
intro: Malus communis subsp. sylvestris, commonly known as wild apple or crabapple, is a subspecies of apple tree that grows in the wild. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include the potential to help manage inflammation and improve digestive health due to its content of fiber, vitamins, and minerals. The therapeutic actions of Malus communis subsp. sylvestris include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential in reducing the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
